Interface UiRenderer

All Known Implementing Classes:
GuiRenderer, TuiRenderer
public interface UiRenderer
This interface defines the methods for any User Interface (UI) in the application. It provides methods for displaying various game elements, handling game phases, and managing user interactions and notifications.
